newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkoku to issue 33.08 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Hokkoku to issue 33.08 mln new shares.

text.p: Hokkoku Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that it will issue 33.08 million new shares at 410 yen per share in order to increase its capital.
The Kanazawa-based regional bank expects to raise 13.56 billion yen through the new issue, the bank said in a statement.
The new shares will be allotted to investors who own Hokkoku Bank shares at the end of January 31, 1997. The bank will allocate 0.1 new share for every one share.
Applications for the new shares should be made between March 5-17, 1997, and the payment is due on March 31, 1997.
Hokkoku shares closed at 800 yen on Wednesday, down six yen from Tuesday's close.
Hokkoku Bank is based in Kanazawa, Ishikawa prefecture, 300 kilometres northwest of Tokyo.
